{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out the -1 values in customer_age, which are sentinel values for missing age
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age and count of valid ages
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
count_valid = len(valid_ages)

mean_age, count_valid"}
